sources.snippet: ## Play Today, Learn for Tomorrow. Support their early learning with toys designed for growing minds. Since 1986 we've been passionate about making eco-friendly toys that kids love to play and learn with. Crafted from sustainable bamboo, it's perfect for creative adventures on the go. This colorful puzzle gives children a fun introduction to tell the time. Designed to encourage children's imaginations, cooperation and motor skills while making gardening fun and educational. You'll even be able to label your own plants with the bamboo plant labels. Perfect for outdoor creativity, this sturdy easel is a must-have for budding artists on their artistic adventures. Bring a prehistoric adventure to family playtime with the Dinosaur Shimmer Floor Puzzle! This 200-piece puzzle features a striking T-Rex silhouette with a mix of classic and dinosaur-shaped pieces, made from durable, premium cardboard with a shimmering finish. Dive into family fun with the Humpback Whale Shimmer Floor Puzzle!
